now = datetime.now()
print('now:', now)

# Determine expiry (treat expiry_month as given)
def card_is_expired(card, now):
    exp_year = int(card['expiry_year'])
    exp_month = int(card['expiry_month'])
    # expired if (year,month) is before current year/month
    return (exp_year, exp_month) < (now.year, now.month)

cards_status = []
for c in cards:
    expired = card_is_expired(c, now)
    cards_status.append((c['payment_card_id'], c.get('card_name'), c.get('expiry_year'), c.get('expiry_month'), expired))
